Words.Word: You are on the edge of reality, traveller. This is the final frontier. Beyond this line is the emptiness in which worlds are born. And it was I who forged their light and darkness!
Shadow, the portal behind him may be our chance for salvation. The Immortals said that they would destroy our world. Maybe with his help?
You won’t survive the portal! It’s terra incognito. The darkness in which worlds can be created. But you cannot create, only destroy. The portal will swallow you whole!
It’s a risk, but do we have any other choice? We may stop the Immortals by entering the portal. But also we may cause a great catastrophe.
Stubborn fool! You humans can only solve problems with brute force. But the universe doesn’t work that way. All these years, and you’ve learned nothing...
Are you afraid of the unknown lurking in the darkness? Now you’ll be left to face it on your own! The world falls to dust and is reborn anew. Following the spiral.
The portal is yours. What is your decision? Take the risk and enter or listen to Tenebris and turn back?
Don’t give up. You have to fight... We are just voices...
We are only visions in your mind... or?
Shadow. Shadow! Wake up already! Look around!
The Underworld... seems somehow new and different, but it’s still the same!
I’m afraid we’ve destroyed the world of the Immortals. Yes, they will come back in a new cycle, as happens inevitable with any life form, but we are responsible for their demise.
We changed places with them. Now you and humanity have a choice: accept the Immortals or become their executioners...
For life and death go hand in hand along the spiral of history, and you can decide which direction the next coil will take.
Can you feel it? The portal is changing!
Shadow, it’s giving us its strength! All the power to mold and shape reality like fresh clay, to create anew. To stop this vicious cycle!
Now we can decide what to do with this world of chaos.
You can destroy it, as the Immortals did, so many times... {br} Or do what even the gods could not — live in peace.

Attack your foe, don`t miss a hit, and your shield power will grow. Accumulate it enough and avenge when enemy hits you.
What a lovely day! I can sense a battle coming, like a storm. Thunder. The untold fury of the legions keeping pace. They are all gifts on my altar!
Rage and thirst for blood boil within her. She delights in endless battle, but for what? What will she find atop her mountain of skulls?
Is the thrill of bloody battle so foreign to you? Fire, passion, tempestuous power! Show what you can do! Entertain me in single-combat or die!
Rise, puppet! And fight! It matters not if you win or lose. When you fight, you serve me!
Imposter! Where is your fury? How can you fight without it? Fight me! Let us begin another dance of blades! I know that war lives in you!

You traveled quite a long path to get here. Why? To save the ungrateful morrrtals? They couldn’t care less about you! I can sense your loneliness, your hunger, and your...fearrr.
Shadow, don’t be fooled! He only seems weak. You’re not his friend, you’re just his prey. He’ll tear you to pieces if you get any closer!
Can you see my brothers? They thirrrst, but their thirst is of a different breed. They crave enterrrtainment. But their hunger is nothing compared to mine!
Creator, you sent me sustenance, but it is not enough. My hunger is eternal, grant me deliverance...
Since you’rrre the chosen one, I’ll give you one last chance to stay with me and feast. Otherrrwise your bones will fall to join the others in the dust.

No, it wasn’t that way. It seems like I won then... likely.
My memories are so vague... I think I won that fight.
I think that wasn’t how that fight ended. Let me try to recall it...
I think it happened another way... Memories can be very fragile.
No, wait... It didn’t happen that way... Please forgive the old man’s forgetfulness.
The magical Sphere made Prince mad! It gave him imminent power... that threatened to destroy us all! I couldn’t allow that to happen.
The pirate girl told me about Widow’s complicated story with Prince. I didn’t get the Sphere, but learn that Prince went to the mountains to find Widow.
Prince’s troubles were caused by a woman! She devised a plan to overthrow him by using a magical Sphere which was now brought to the nearby port...
The Hermit told us that Prince’s warlord, Shogun, betrayed his lord and paid a certain Butcher to kidnap him. It was now time to visit the bandit.
Last time I was telling you how I’ve saved Prince from killers. I’ve learnt that a Hermit was secretly training his soldiers. So that was where we went.
Change is imminent, human. For now, sleep. When you wake up, no one will remember your feat. It needs to be that way. One day you shall understand...
Wait! I have so many questions! Who are you? What is there, behind the Gates? I want to know...
You’re not dreaming. I’ve stopped the time to take the Sphere back to the shadow. Its presence here was a mistake caused by the instability of the Gates of Shadows.
You, too, old man, want to claim my throne?! I own it by birthright! No one shall take it from me!
Prince, stop! Look around! The Sphere is feeding upon your anger, turning you into a monster!
Weakling! You’re not even good enough to be my lord’s court jester. I’ll crush you with a single blow!
Here you are, my loyal friend! Look—justice triumphs again, Shogun is my faithful dog. His mind is mine!
I’ve never seen Prince so... wild. His eyes were flaming! He thought it to be funny to execute a traitor in the place where we first met. I’ll show you...
There is no way back for me. I see that you want to help, but it’s too late—Prince took the Sphere already. Shogun was trying to defend it, but in vain.
I sympathize with you, I truly do. But a broken heart is a poor advisor. Please understand: there are people suffering because of you.
Prince humiliated me by rejecting and laughing at my feelings. Now I shall strike back! You are his friend, so you’ll deliver this message to him...
My lady is so fair! I was unworthy of seeing her face... Now my life belongs to her. I will protect her honor till my last breath.
My lady is like a sister to me. I can feel her pain. She forbids me from touching Prince, thus my anger shall fall upon you!
He’s been telling me of your kindness, honor, and dignity. But I don’t believe any male’s words any more. Each of you shall suffer!
Are you coming to humiliate me the way Prince did? You males are all the same...
We must stop Prince before he finds Widow... and the Sphere...
Widow wants to rule men and to play them off one against another. The Sphere shall make her chosen one great... and absolutely loyal to her.
Widow loved Prince, but he rejected her. Then she found herself a new toy: Shogun. The hag is using the stupid warlord for her revenge.
Stop—I’ve underestimated you, ol’ man! I’ve been paid for delivery, but I got no business fighting for Widow’s honor. I’ll show you to her hiding place!
What shall I tell my father? His daughter having melted and losing a fight to an old man? That ain’t gonna happen as long as I’m the heir to the pirates’ throne!
Threatening my captain? She saved me from thralldom, and I swore to work off my freedom. Let the spirits be kind to you...
Do you believe in fortune? I think I gonna make my fortune today by takin’ all yer monies. You think you’ll have some luck, ol’ man?
Thing is that I don’t have the Sphere any more. Widow’s men took it yesterday. Dunno who you are, but I never forgive liars. Keelhaul ‘im!
Widow? Of course... she told me to take the Sphere and bring it to Shogun, into his own hands.
Widow sends you to take the Sphere? Aren’t you a bit too old for jobs like that? Ah, why should I care. Get on board.
Go to the port. Shogun is waiting for a ship to arrive, bringing the Sphere. It is Prince’s last chance to reclaim his throne.
A certain woman convinced Shogun that the throne is his by right. She promised he'll have the Sphere, becoming a great warlord. All that for being her liege.
I know that as soon as Prince draws his last breath, Shogun won’t let me live. I’m just a tool; I am expendable. So—I shall help you.
Answer me, why does Shogun want him dead, and what is the magic Sphere you were talking about?
Hee-hee! Look at Prince taking to his heels! You should’ve seen your face, old man. See—your new friend is a spineless liar!
Nobody dares to doubt my authority! The family never forgives that. You’re not leaving alive!
The game comes into the bag! Philosophy is for dorks—as for me, I just like playing with knives. Wanna play with me?
Butcher showed me how pain reveals our true self. I am free now! You can find happiness, too. Do not resist!
His silence is louder than words, old man. Me—I’m honest with myself, adopting my bestial nature. He’s not. But we shall teach you humility! Come, children!
So this is what “luck” means? Buying your freedom, and feeding your people to a gang of madmen... And I was so kind towards you, prince.
How dare you soiling my name! You... you miserable wretch! I’m back to put an end to your reign of cruelty!
The prodigal son is back! Have you considered my proposal, Prince—that of my letting you go and telling the whereabouts of the Sphere, and you paying me gold?
Butcher dwells with his gang not far from here. They were your kidnappers, sire. Go—I wish you finding your answers.
MY men! Placing him at the head of my army was a mistake... If you still have at least a mite of honor, tell us where the bandits’ camp is!
Try to understand: our art is at it’s end! In order to survive it needs to change. I know how. And Shogun promised me protection for training his men.
Shame on you! Selling your honor outright! And what for? Do you think people shall follow a traitor’s lead? Is that a good example for the young?
You’re a victim of circumstances, Prince, a sacrifice needed for common good. My school shall attain greatness, and the golden age of martial arts shall begin!
Master told us about the world of shadows, about its dwellers and its imminent powers he’ll share with us. Do you think I’ll let you take this all from us?
Change is imminent! I’ve crossed half the world to learn it, sacrificed so much... Master’s wisdom is all that I have!
Lynx, this arrogant youth, hasn’t coped with his task. I’ll have to do his job. Disciples, front and center!
You are between a rock and a hard place, my lord. I admit having betrayed you. I had no choice though, for the future of my school is at stake.
Too many coincidences. Someone knew of our visit, and warned the bandits. But how is the Hermit involved? We have to learn this. Let’s go!
I took a unit of men to him in order to make things clear, but I was taken captive. However, luck was still on my side, and I could escape.
I’ve learnt something I wasn’t supposed to: my soldiers study forbidden practices under a certain Hermit. They wanted to remove me as a witness...
Thank you! You’ve noble, for few would stand up for someone they don’t know. I thought death was near, for these people know nothing of mercy.
I can’t just leave. I’ve already been paid for Prince’s life. Nothing personal here, old man.
Our clan does work that is too dirty even for the gods. We solve problems and correct others’ mistakes. And you are one of these.
Do you like my tattoos? In the land where I was born the strongest get such as souvenirs of their feats. You’ll soon be part of the picture, too...
Do what you want. They don't pay me for talking. Two heads means more money. Get them, boys!
Really? For what I see is a frightened man surrounded by cutthroats. Something suggests that the Prince is telling the truth. Step away from him!
Don’t listen to Prince, old man, he just went mad. We’re taking His Highness home before he hurts himself. Your help is not required.
Help! These people want to kill me!
Once upon a time, I was taking a walk and met the local lord who was in dire distress...

Are you trying to correct your mistake? You opened the Gates, but only the Eternals can eliminate the Shadow contagion. Not being one of us, you are weak.
You shall die, like all the rest. Magma flows through my veins, and it will cover all the land, cleansing it for new life.
What cellar is this and what are we doing here?
This is the antechamber of the Eternals' domain. Their slumber lasted for millennia, but the Gates of Shadows have put the world in peril. They've awakened.
Cool – that means they’ll help us deal with the Gates quick and easy!
Oh, no. They shall destroy the Gates, but they shall also destroy the whole of mankind. For them it’s only another cycle of destruction and creation.
Of all the Eternals, I was the first to awaken. Many fighters will come to die by my hand; I shall complete my mission.
I have been telling my brethren that it is my duty to decide the planet’s destiny. Watch, unbelievers, as my blaze blankets the land!
Enough! I concede. But know this: you have roused my brother. Be not deceived by his appearance, for he is quick and deadly!
I saw some half-ruined dwellings and a huge statue. Are there humans living here?
Only fanatics. They worship the Eternals in hope to be spared. Truly, they are blind in their faith. If we fail, they will soon learn the truth.
This mine is a sacred place. Why are you here? Leave and meet your destiny with honor. The last thing you will hear is the earth trembling beneath your feet.
I've treated humans kindly, a rare trait among the Eternals. I helped your species many times. So run and say your last goodbyes to your dear ones!
Damnation! Shall I have to wait for thousands of years again? I've moved continents! Cleansing the earth was my role!
My great-grandfather told me of the Eternals fighting for the right to hurl their retribution upon mankind. We are now in the middle of their war.
You have poisoned the land, and now my mushrooms are dying. They shall absorb your mind, and we shall all be one, human. That will be the end of your story!
Begone! And revel in the last minutes of your fragile lives!
My brethren have forgotten themselves playing gods. Worship makes them soft. But destruction is in humanity's nature; the world will be better without you.
Floods, fires, earthquakes – these were all works of their hands! I am starting to see the whole thing clearly…
In a way, it’s a shame we dealt with him so easily. I wish I could see what a mushroom armageddon looks like.
Dark waters will engulf the earth and the Gates of Shadows! Their secret will be lost in the abyss. And there will be no one left on the surface to tell it!
For thousands of years I’ve watched the withering of your kind. There is some beauty in it. I think I shall keep you alive – just for fun.
For the first time in thousand years a human wins. Your will to live is so strong! But whatever you do, the end shall be the same: you will die.
I pray you tell us, o most ancient one, does not mankind have a chance to atone for its sins against you?
Your fate is already decided, you only choose the way in which your lives shall end. But the decision belongs not to me, but to the one who knows no mercy.
We have been dealing with humans for so long that we've learned to understand you. But the one who rules us had no such desire. You will soon know that.
Your courage can be only matched by your folly. But I knew that you shall come, for you are my fate, and I am yours. I shall rewrite your destinies – forever.
Be cautious, hero. This deep, the universal laws that you’re used to cease to work...
That`s right! Hold the boy on the leash. I know all about your destinies: who you are, and where you are going. Shall I tell you who dies in the end?
Your fate is solved. You have already lost once you've set foot on my abode’s threshold. Will you have enough courage to rewrite your story?
I know mankind. You walk up and down the same spiral. I’ve seen that more than once. Self-destruction and withering. Nothing can change that. Such is your fate.
The Maker is more skilled in weaving the threads of fate than me. He is testing your kin, for he wants a decent rival.{br}Go, human. Suffer his ire.
Blind fanatics! You remember me and feed me with your faith in the Father. A parent can be strict, and you'll accept my punishment with gratitude...
I know his kind. They gather adepts whom they feed with lies. Don't listen to his firebrand preaching, for that is his primary weapon.
Wrong, old man. I have some hard iron for the refractory children, too. You will be praying me to let you join the family... but I shall be implacable.
Black sheep, you are unworthy of a place by my side. Begone! I shall send word to the Creator of how you men have failed again, and he shall feed my children.
Whom shall I worship in this last hour of mine? O Creator, why hast thou forsaken me? Thou gave me power to lead them, but I have failed thee... again.
All your life is only an illusion. And we are its creators. We shall drive you mad while others count upon brute force. Fire, water, diseases - hah!
"We"? Shadow, it seems like our foe is off his head. Excuse me, which of your personalities are we talking with? Perhaps your "brother" could be more rational?
Laughing at us, human? My brother suggests your souls to be sent to the abyss of eternal misery... Then your world shall yield, without a single drop of blood.
I would've killed you, for my mercy is truly boundless. But my brother is less tolerant; you're free to go, in case if you don't lose your wits on the way out.
Where are you, brother? I can't hear your voice anymore! Truly, being locked all alone is worse than fire or blade... Go, stupid ones. The Father is waiting.

By the mercenaries' code of honor I must give away my weapon in case of my loss. But I'm very good at my trade!
Coward! Can't believe I've wasted my time on you. What a disgrace!
I've been watching you for all that time. You're going pretty well, so I'm obliged to stop you now. I've been warned about your skill by my master.
I've managed to find out how much she's been paid for your head. Nova doesn't care who pays, and we don't need any gossip about your loss...
So you wish to try once more? That's the spirit!
We shouldn't let her go! She's going to tell everything to her master... I fear the one who hired her is related to Titan somehow.
Accepting her defeat, Nova hands over her knuckles as she promised.
How strange... We've traveled so many days, and yet there are no signs of life. No people, no animals, no trees... Nothing but a huge wasteland.
This land is close to the Gates of Shadows and has suffered greatly. I remember fertile plains once surrounded the great Ivory City...
Look! That glow in the distance – it’s the Ivory City! It's burning! How can that be? It's supposed to be full of people! Can we still help them?
You, there – halt! If you drop your weapons and come out where I can see, I promise you a swift and painless death.
You... The Prince! But... But, you should be dead! It's impossible! Troops, fall back!
Interesting... This fool seems to think you are some 'prince'. I think you should play along.
Look, Captain! There he is, just as I said! The Prince has returned from the grave!
Coward! I should have hanged you long ago. Step aside, so that I may deal with this beggar and prove he is no Prince.
Mercy, o Prince! I will leave this city; I’ll never take up a weapon again, only spare my worthless life. Please, my lord!
A Prince, huh? Have you been keeping secrets from us?
No, this is obviously a case of mistaken identity. But, if they fear him, it is all the better.
So, you are the impostor who pretends to be my master! Your deceit insults his memory. For that, you will pay!
Forgive me for doubting you, my Prince. I fear Shogun's lies have entangled my mind.
My defeat will do you no good, monster. Shogun knows you are here. Whatever you are planning, he will stop you...
Ha-ha! That was the fastest running away I've seen in a while. That'll show you, losers!
So... Here you are, after all of these years. What took you so long? Have you found another realm to ruin with your greed and incompetence?
I see my assassins haven't failed completely. You're only a shadow of the Prince I knew.
Did you really think you could match my power? I have conquered countless lands! Enslaved whole nations! Even Kings bow before me!
No... This is impossible... I am invincible! I cannot lose, not now! And you... you think you can take my empire away from me? Hah!
Well done, my disciple. You now have all six Seals needed to close the Gates. But don't celebrate just yet. First, we must reach the Gates...
Long time no see, Shadow. You didn't think we would just disappear, did you?
It's six against one this time. You will never reach the Gates!
When we're done with him, I get whatever is left of his body!
We were the strongest warriors who ever lived and yet we failed to defeat you...
You don't belong to this world. No one is that powerful...
Don't think you've seen the last of us. We'll meet again soon, Shadow. Until then, enjoy your victory.
Finally, we have reached the Gates of Shadows... The sight of it is hard to bear. You have everything you need to close them forever, except for one thing.
Only those made of flesh and bone can use the Seals. I would gladly do it if I were not so old. I can still shatter a brick wall with my fist, but my life energy is draining fast.
Hey, don't look at me! I like you guys, but there is no profit in dying or becoming another shadow. Good luck though!
May! No, this cannot be! Something has gone terribly wrong!
An unexpected turn of events... I'm truly sorry about your friend, Shadow.
This was a bad idea from the start. But now, we must open the Gates once more to save May. Any ideas?
The Seals! Each one appears to be connected to its owner somehow. We should revisit each owner – perhaps we will learn how to break the Seals.
What? Are you serious?.. Oh, what am I saying – of course you're serious... Well, Lynx is first in line, so I guess we should start there.
So, you're back. You expect me to just sit here while you open the Gates? No, I can't let you do that! Not again!
Ah! The voice! I still hear Titan's voice inside my head! You don't understand the power you're dealing with. You've doomed us all!
Everyone was so afraid of my magic, but there are far more powerful forces at work here – things we don't understand, but we know they should be feared.
Do not think that you can fully comprehend Titan's powers! He can change one's thoughts, feelings, and memories! How do you fight that?
You think I'm the monster? You haven't seen what Titan does to his enemies... I have, and it sickens even me.
Why do you persist? No one wants you to open the Gates. Someone will be strong enough to stop you!
Believe me, you do not want to see what lies beyond the Gates. Forget your friend; it's not too late to turn back!
Titan's minions are like nothing you've ever seen before. You think you're prepared? It's never enough!
Titan's been leading you from the very beginning! Pulling your strings like a puppet master. Even now you do what he wishes.
Until Titan finds the way through the Gates, this is my realm, and I will not allow you to take it from me!
Why do you hasten your own demise? Leave now and enjoy what little time your world has left before Titan destroys you all.
Now that they're taken care of, what's next?
Now it is up to Shadow. He has the tools and the experience. He is finally ready.
This is suicide. I know May is your friend... but do you really want to do this?
You must go! There is no time for debate. It is now or never!
No matter what happens, it was an honor to travel with you, Shadow.
Have no fear, my apprentice. Your heart is pure, your resolve is strong. Trust in yourself and your training, and you cannot fail.
I'm no villain. I've given these children a gift. The gift of strength, violence! You'll see. They'll be the top of the food chain because of my teachings!
There is no going back now. Our path leads us across the sea. We must find a boat.
Hey, didn't that guy say he had a boat waiting for him? Let's go catch him at the docks before he leaves!
You again? What kind of trouble are you going to cause me this time? Well, I'll help you. Just this once! But I'm still angry. Cast off!

I've always dreamed of excitement and adventure. What are we standing around for? Let's go!
Ah, the first Seal. Well done, Shadow. Only five Seals left. Come, we must hurry!
My apprentice is missing. I'm worried for his safety. He left to try the new schools in the next town, but I have not heard from him since.
Enemy attacks are much more powerful than yours.
You can only fight if your ranged weapon is level {0} or higher.
You are very skilled for one so young. I will share my secret with you, but you must complete a task in return.
Butcher, the gang leader in the nearby village, threatens me. He wants my magic. Get rid of him and you'll have earned my favor.
You have shown great skill, Shadow. I trust that you can wield this magic for good. But do not allow it to tempt you or taint your good heart.
Great! I can't wait to see this. How about we find some targets to practice your new power on?
You tempt Titan with your meddling! We don't know where he came from, only that he is... different. He creates strange things to serve him...
No! It cannot be... All the glory of the Order within your grasp, but you only seek the Seal?
Fine! You have won your precious trinket. Be gone from my sight, but be warned: I will not forget what you have done!
Ha! You can't beat me, Shadow. Why do you even try?
So I'm the only one left? Sensei, Sly, come on! This is no time to fear for your own skin!
No?.. Fine! Be like that! Nobody needs your help anyway! Let's go, Shadow!
I'm the leader of the Assassin's Order; you are not worthy of fighting me! At least your "battle" with Shin was entertaining.
Who is this lowly worm before me? I'll not waste my time fighting the likes of you.
Here's Shin, the weakest apprentice in my Order. First, defeat him... if you can. Perhaps then will you have the honor of fighting me.
What have I done? Widow said everyone would kneel to me if I agreed to help her!
She said betraying my father was the only way to show men that women should rule.
This is not our war, but I am curious about Widow.
Me too! She’s obviously a worthy opponent. Let’s pay her a visit, shall we?
How does it feel to defeat a woman? And you're the one who'll close the Gates of Shadows? You have no idea how quickly their power will tear you apart!
I'm feeling a bit... dizzy. Widow's spell turned me into a weak-willed, love-sick maniac! Thanks for saving me. I owe you a big one.
She's really freaking me out, guys! She's right though. I feel like something dark and terrifying is yet to come. We need to be careful!
Stay focused. The Gates of Shadows are close. There may be strange, frightening things ahead for us, but we must not fail.
I... I don't understand. How could one so small defeat me?
Such an insignificant creature like you is hardly a challenge for me. Prepare to be crushed, little man!
I am defeated? Impossible! The Order will not ignore this outrage! You will be hunted and punished, Shadow!
There's nowhere for you to run, nowhere to hide. The Order will stop at nothing to defeat you.
But that won't be necessary, for I shall land the killing blow and bring honor to my Master!
My defeat only serves to strengthen Lynx. With each battle he learns more of your moves, your skill, and thus, how to defeat you.
I beat Lynx easily the first time I fought him. However, when I removed his mask I saw only a dummy.
Then I felt his claws digging into the back of my neck. I have served him ever since.
I've grown bored of this life, the Order. I wish to return to my true place, my seat of high power. But don't think that Lynx will be so easy. He will not fail!
Honor and tradition? Ha! The Order is merely a playground for me, a minor amusement, a way to hone my already impressive sword skills.
And I am more than happy to show my skills to you now.
You think defeating my guards proves your strength? They were weaklings, pawns, easily forgotten and replaced.
But the Order has need of one with your skill, your drive. You must choose: join us or suffer.
This town was known for its fighting schools, yet it lies in ruin! So much destruction... what could have done this?
Let's find someone who can tell us what's happened. There's a young man over there; maybe he can help.
You! Tell us: what's happening here?
You're here for Hermit's competition, no doubt. Stand in line, though you'll never get a chance to try.
I can't believe you beat me... Hermit came here with nothing, yet built the best fighting school in the east!
Perhaps... humility is the lesson I must learn if I am to ever open my own school.
I am the true chosen one; the only one worthy of Hermit's teachings. I will prove it and then open my own school. Prepare yourself for defeat!
You beat me – so what? Competitions are for fools, not real warriors. The only way to truly earn Hermit's knowledge is to take it by force!
You seem like a smart fighter. Want a leg up in the competition? I know Hermit's secret. You can have it... for a price.
Excellent doing business with you. You won't regret it. I'll be back in a bit for delivery.
Time is money, and you've just cost me both. Oh well, it's your loss.
Look at the destruction one old man has brought. Imagine what I'll do with such power. Get out of my way; I must get Hermit's secret knowledge!
Heed my warnings! Magic has no place in martial arts. It dirties the mind, clouds the focus, and in the wrong hands it can bring destruction and despair.
Magic! So that is Hermit's great secret. Beware, my apprentice, magic is dangerous and powerful. It should not be used!
Sensei is right, Shadow. Magic is too dangerous to allow just anyone to have it. But you... imagine what you'll be capable of with such a power!
No one should posses such power. This competition is pointless. I will win and the secret will end with me.
There is no shame in being bested by a good soldier.
War is the only constant – with Hermit's magic, I will conquer all who oppose me... starting with you!
Crane, how far you have fallen. What have you become? Forsaking the old ways? Forgetting all I have taught you? Shame on you!
Forgive me, Sensei. I have brought shame to you and to myself. Your apprentice has shown me the error of my ways.
Sensei, my old teacher. Come to witness the new way? Your teachings are outdated, unimaginative! And this new apprentice... weak and unworthy!
Could you be the one I have been waiting for? Let us test your skills!
You lack focus! Pay attention now and try again.
Hey, guys! How's it going? I'm Bird, it's nice to meet you. Welcome to our little town.
How strange for this girl to walk alone at night, talking to strangers. I have a bad feeling about this.
Don't be so worried, old man! There's nothing fishy going on here. She's just being friendly!
Only the strongest survive! I teach them, train them, raise them to cut and shred! Meddling fools – now I'll teach you a different lesson!
You'll return over and over again until I spill every last drop of your blood. Bring it on!
Please don't hurt me! I just got mixed up with the wrong people, that's all. Let me go and I promise to stop tricking travelers.
Wanna see some sights? I'll show you my favorite part of town first – it'll take your breath away... once and for all.
Please have mercy! Butcher doesn't know about our relationship. He thinks love makes you weak. Please don't tell him about us!
Your fight with Hermit destroyed my business! Now everyone knows the secret.
I'll have to think of a new plan... I'll have plenty of time for that. A ship awaits me. Farewell.
No; you've hurt Bird! You will pay for what you've done to my love!
I don't understand. Why didn't anyone come to my aid? Could it be that Butcher... used me? No. No, I refuse to believe it!
Butcher is our leader, our guiding star. Even more, he raised me from a little boy. I owe him everything. We all do!
It used to be all about having fun, breaking rules, being young. But things have changed so much. This... cult... is too serious. It's not fun anymore.
Hermit warned us about Butcher's gang, but this... this is much worse. He has been misleading children, turning them, building his own private army!
That's disgusting! How could he do such a thing? Give me your sword and I'll kill him myself!
You've met Bull, that worthless fool? It was Butcher himself that killed his parents. I always thought it was a mistake letting that little brat live.
My defeat means nothing. This island will be your grave. Butcher will take your life away.
I hear the gentle whisper of your blood speaking to me. Come, and I will free it from that confining cocoon.
Have you heard anything about the place we are heading? Who is in charge?
Of course I've heard! Some time ago the Pirate King disappeared. His daughter, Wasp, took over and now controls this harbor.
It's said Wasp has a magic amulet which brings luck to its owner...
An amulet, you say? That sounds familiar. I wonder if that's the item we've been searching for...
Getting to Wasp won't be easy. She's had some trouble recently and has gone into hiding. Anyway, not my problem. A job awaits! Good luck!
So, you're a tough one, eh? Let's see how far you get...
Ah, so you've met these "New Blood" fellas. Some of Wasp's crewmen mutinied and took over her ships.
She's got a few loyal henchmen by her side, but they're still in hiding... oh, I should be going!
I saw you deal with that mutineer bilge rat Kraken. You know, Wasp could use a warrior like you.
Deal with the rest of those New Blood fools and the captain will make you rich!
Who the hell are you? This port is closed. But... You've got a nice ship there – I claim it in the name of New Blood!
You've chosen the wrong side, lad. When Wasp is through with you, you'll disappear just like her father! Mark my words!
The Pirate King disappears without a trace, Wasp takes over, and nobody asks where her father went!
She had something to do with it, I tell ya. I don't trust that wench, and neither should you!
Your strength belongs with New Blood! The Pirate King disappeared because of his ungrateful daughter – and you’re helping spread her lies!
Wasp's old dogs sent you, eh? They put their money on the wrong guy. I’ll hoist you over the yardarm and you’ll sink like all the rest!
We stand to lose this war because of the likes of you. Brothers killing brothers, and you profit from their suffering. You won't leave this city alive!
So, you've dealt with the mutineers and have come for your reward?
Wasp was going to give you an audience until she saw you with that petty profiteer Sly! He's been selling weapons to New Blood!
Sly! Is this true? Have you armed their enemies?
I can explain everything! But now isn't the time... can you help a friend out here?
If only the Pirate King were here – none of this would be happening! Damn that girl and her selfish acts!
What's that silly girl gotten herself into now? If it weren't for me, Wasp would be long dead. You're just another mess for me to clean up!
I should thank you, honestly. Before you came, I had two problems: the mutineers and my so-called "advisors" trying to restrict my control.
But now, thanks to you, I'm the only one in power here!
That’s it? That’s all you’ve got? Weak! Get up and fight me for real... if you can!
Well, what do we have here? An interesting specimen... I've met so many men, so boring, so average.
But... There's something peculiar about this one. I'll keep my eye on you.
An interesting specimen? She's so full of herself! Shadow is above flattery.
She must be the woman Wasp spoke of. Something is... bothering me, but I am not sure what.
She doesn't scare me... but all these bodies do. My God, it's a slaughterhouse! And look at the damage from the siege engines!
I came as a marauder, but something changed. There's a light in my heart for Widow. But I failed. I... I am not worthy of her affection.
I can't forget that beautiful woman! Her face is all I see when I close my eyes.
I spent all my money on a gift for her – surely, these precious gems will tell her how I feel about her.
You did what? Are you feeling all right?
Am I all... No! No, I'm not all right! What's happening to me? This is maddening!
Widow is my goddess! I would give all the riches in the world just to see her smile at me.
I saw the way you were looking at her... her face will be the last thing you ever see!
She came from nowhere as we hunted. We were dumbstruck. When I finally came to my senses, blood stained my hands, and my brothers were no more...
All these men are vying for Widow's affection. But they're not thinking straight – they've been charmed. That's why they're attacking!
Sly's gone mad, too. But, Sensei, why doesn't it affect you?
I feel her pull, too, but I am skilled enough to resist the power.
I'm the last of my tribe. The spirits showed me the way to the most miraculous woman I've ever seen.
I sacrificed much to attract her attention; I can't allow you to steal her from me now!
Am I cursed? Love has driven me to madness and brought me to my knees, turning me into a mindless youth.
But my body can't keep up with my ambitions. I'm just a lonely, pathetic, old man.
Maybe I'm not as young or strong as I used to be, but my experience will win over your arrogance! The woman will be mine.
She has a strange power over men, beyond her beauty – it's magic! I can't resist, but I see her true nature.
She is cruel and evil. I'm begging you: free me from this misery!
You'll go no farther. Widow has chosen me as her favored watchdog, and I am to stop anyone from coming to see her. Prepare to feel my fists!
You're a perfect representative of your kind – vain and self-satisfied!
Widow will punish you and turn you into her favorite little toy. Mark my words!
I don't need some magic spell to love Widow. Her power over men excites me.
Love is the perfect way to rob you men of your free will. But somehow you're beyond her control... so I'll fix it!
Such a powerful young man – you'll be a perfect addition to my collection.
Fight my magic all you want; I like the struggle. No matter, I'll win and you'll stay by my side forever!
I'll be here when you're ready to try again. A worthy adversary such as yourself... we could be good friends. Or perhaps more?
It will be full of trickery and illusion. Take care, my disciple, and be ready for anything.
You should have never returned, Prince. Did you think your former subjects would submit to you after what you did?
Your highborn head has no place here, except on the end of a pike!
I know you have no mercy for the defeated, Prince.
But whatever torture you've prepared, it will not compare to the fate awaiting those who fail to carry out Shogun's will.
They used your name to scare children, yes. But I brought them order; I gave them the Empire! My people won't follow a petty prince now...
Perhaps, but we must be careful. No natural fire can burn so long; this realm belongs to the shadows now.
Seals are broken and the Gates of Shadows are open again. There is nothing left for our hero but to meet his most dangerous and powerful foe – Titan.
Whether he’ll rescue May and return his body or not you shall find out very soon!

Search the Stone Grove for the ancient one.
Cronos is hiding among the Factory facilities. You must find him!
Weapons down. Come with me. Titan awaits your arrival.
Glad I made it in time! Get up; we must leave quickly. Shroud will not stay unconscious for long!
My name's Kali. Pleased to meet you... Shadow? That's an interesting name. Come on, I'll take you somewhere safe.
Who have you brought here, Kali? Did you forget we're in hiding?
Listen, Cypher! This is Shadow; I saw him come through the Gates, and he's still alive. It's a miracle! But Shroud was his welcoming committee.
Shroud himself? Interesting... So, Shadow, you must be quite important to Titan if he sent his best fighter to fetch you. That makes you important to us, too.
You should rest here. We can't allow you to leave the compound just yet, for your own safety... and ours.
Kali, give our guest a tour. We will speak later.
Here you'll meet heroes from innumerable planes. They found themselves stuck here after Titan annexed their worlds, adding them to his vast domain.
Cypher managed to unite them under his command, but they can be difficult to deal with. You'll have to earn their respect.
There's a looters' camp not far from here. There might be something useful there, but the camp is heavily guarded. Will you help?
Titan never conquered a world without resistance. Each time a champion arises to stop him.
But every champion has failed - and after that, another world followed his fate. I saw that with my own eyes.
Shroud was once such a champion. He lost, and compromised with his conscience. Titan spared his life, but made a faithful slave out of him.
You don't yet understand what you're dealing with, boy. Titan is a monster, a parasite for whom life itself means nothing.
Your fight against Titan is inevitable, but the outcome is not predetermined. You will need more than just your strength. Show me all you've got!
You're strong, capable. But Titan is no simple brute. He can harrow your mind, leaving no chance to defend. His will turns into your will. But there's a way.
Before Titan came, an ancient tribe lived here. Their wills were strong. He was unable to turn them into his mindless soldiers, so he ordered their destruction.
But one of these ancients escaped and hid... somewhere. I tried to use Cronos, my greatest creation, to find him.
Oh, I remember that one. He returned insane, and then just ran away again. That was a real mess...
The ancient one is powerful. He wiped Cronos' memory, replacing it with an idea to cleanse this world of all vices. He's likely near one of Titan's factories.
So, it seems that Cronos is our best chance at finding the ancient one. Let's go!
How dare you approach the voice of the ancients? Their ghosts scream in anger over Titan's foul touch upon their once beautiful land! Show your true face, beast!
Well, he's switched off. Let me check his memory chip. And... Done! The ancient one is in the Stone Grove. It's a real tomb, but we have no choice. Let's go!
No. It can't be him! This must be some kind of trap!
So, you've finally come to face me. I've been waiting for you, Shadow. We have unfinished business to attend to.
What fate is in store for Shadow? Will he defeat Titan and rescue May? Find out in the second chapter in early 2015!
What’s that? Some kind of money from your world? Funny. But they’re nothing but junk here. Our coins are different. Here, take some as my gift.

You know... uh, there was an old custom that few remember. One could, uh, entertain the Festive Spirit with a small donation to keep him around a while longer.
What? Do you want to try again? Wouldn't you rather make me some gingerbread cookies instead? You've got to be a better baker than a fighter, ho ho ho!
I see, I see! You are an expert fighter, which means you train a lot. Good kids get good gifts. And you deserve some of my best!
Are you sure? I doubt you'll ever see him again if you quit now.

You'll only be remembered as a vulgar copycat of Trickster the Great! I stake my nunchaku on you not being worth the dust on my sandals!
Coward! What kind of a man refuses a challenge?
Is all that noise about you? I was the main greatest sensation that happened to this town before you! Show me what you're good for, upstart!
Money can cure a wounded pride. Shadow, I’m sure this bumpkin will gladly show off once more, and earn some dough as well.
Right! My martial arts cost a few coins! Very well; I’ll show you a feint or two. Watch and admire!
This guy sure is unruly, but... perhaps you could still learn something from him? Let's try!
Fine. I admit, I was too excited. It happens, huh? Perhaps I need more self-control. Here, take my nunchaku. You earned it.
Hermit’s tournament is just a vanity fair. It’s mastery that matters, not brute strength! My naginata could be yours, if you're skillful enough.
I hoped to meet one who cared about the spirit of martial arts. But you seem to be like all the rest, seeking strength as if it could solve all your problems.
I travel the land, searching for the perfect rival, but I've yet to meet one. Could you be the one I’m looking for?
He may be a stranger to vanity, but not to gambling. I bet he likes the sound of coins jingling even more than the sound of punching fists.
So, you want to place a bet? I like your courage! Yes, I'll give you another chance. After all, no one is born a true master.
Wait, Shadow! Don’t go! Having his naginata could turn the tide of the tournament in our favor!
I bow to you, friend. Take my weapon; you earned it. My next quest. . . a new life goal. Perhaps a martial arts school of my own?
Doncha be scared, kitten. Here, like my katana? You males are so fond of shiny toys. It's yours if you can beat me!
He-he! If you're 'fraid to fight a woman, I'm at ease 'bout my master's future. You're no threat to him!
I'm Butcher’s favorite wife! I won’t letcha touch my master’s sacred face!
I don’t think this lady is incorruptible. Let’s offer her some coin to spare us a little more of her precious time.
Butcher gives me more as pocket change! But fine. I'll fight another match with you. It'll be my easiest money ever!
If she’s indeed Butcher’s favorite wife, we have a perfect chance to send him a message. Let him be scared of us!
Kill that fatso! And do it with my sword - I want him know what it was like for me, attending to all his wishes. Give Butcher my regards!
I’ve been fighting off those bloodsuckers for ages! If I’m not lucky today, you’ll have the dearest thing I own: my spear.
So you’re not one of the pirates? Sorry, son. Go in peace then.
Screw you all and all your brawls! I am a peaceful man. I want no part in your war! Just let me live and work in peace!
Let's offer the old man some money and ask him to fight once again. We could use his spear, and he could use several coins to escape from this hole of a port.
I’ll take your money, fine, but don’t think I’ll make it easy this time! I am a man of principle!
It’s better if you take his weapon and let him go. Wasp’s men would hardly be that kind to him.
You’ll make better use of this spear than me, son. I should keep to my fishing rod. And you – I trust that you will go and put an end to this carnage.
Let’s play a game, uh? I win - you carry me on yer back right to the Widow’s place. I lose, you get my wep.
Yo, homie, you’re a snore! Just like 'em all 'ere. Okay, I’ll go find someone funky.
Well now! Whadawe have 'here? Got something nice, uh? Wanna me split yer head wi’ me kusarigama?
Try offering him money. I’m not sure if he has any use for it, but he’s got a very nice weapon. Won’t ask where he stole it from.
Yo! Scrillas! That’s my boy. Willin’ to pay for being beaten!
You have to stop this psycho at all costs. Who knows what a mess he can make if left unattended?
No way! You won! Well, that was some fight. Here, grab my kusarigama. Imma go give knuckle sandwiches to 'em local blunderers.
This engagement has been the sole purpose of my life. My way ends here. If you win, you will have my weapon.
You will not fight? For such a coward as you are, dying with honor would have been a reward greater than living in fear. So I shall leave you to your misery.
My sire died by your hand, Prince. When you disappeared, I thought his death would remain unavenged. I’m glad to see the hour of vengeance has come.
I bet a couple of coins could persuade him to fight again. Ronins don't receive a wide welcome nowadays. I’ve heard of them literally starving!
Though not a great warrior, you have that grit that might have helped you to defeat my sire once. So let us see what you can do this time.
No, no. We cannot let him go! The others must have no cause to doubt your being their Great Prince!
This combat was a fair one. That means that you deserved winning that first time, too. Take my sword, Prince, and let it serve you well.
Fear not. I can take many a form, this being only one. True Shroud shall not be seen here any longer.
Shadow is the champion who's come to defeat Titan! Will you help us?
Thou shall not see Titan. For this is what thou needs to know: many claimed to fight him before. Each of them found me, talked to me, so strong and proud.
As time passed, I saw each one of them on Titan’s leash, their eyes empty, devastating their own homeworlds. History repeats itself over and over again...
You don’t understand! Shadow is different, outstanding! If you help us, Titan will fall! You’d know that if you saw what Shadow went through to get here!
Enough! I want to know nothing! Only one was "outstanding". And he failed like all the rest. But it does not matter. It is all in the past now.
Let me show thee some of those who came before. I keep them in my memory - all of them...
Fight them, each with his own rules coming from his own world, and thou shall see what fine warriors fell under Titan's feet.
Shadow, do you copy? You've impressed our fighters, but another wishes to spar under special rules. Meet him at the Hideout if you want. Over and out.
Shadow, it’s Cypher speaking. There is yet another fighter at the Hideout who would like to spar with you.
Yes, thou art strong, Shadow, and well instructed in the art of fighting.
But please, forget about confronting Titan. Hide, like I do. Let me help. Here: I shall change thine form. Thou shalt look like one of his men...
Don’t be ridiculous. You know he will not stop.
Then – my need to stop thee is that much greater. Titan shall not have another slave-soldier, strong as thou art.
Indeed thou art full of might, O Shadow, and strong beyond all measure. For even Shroud could never overcome me when I sparred with him.
I trusted in him. He had prospect, and grip, and will. He could have been the long-expected liberator. But Titan made him an enslaver instead.
But do you now believe that Shadow has a chance against Titan? Will you help us?
It has been a long time since I have believed in anything. Begone. I have nothing for thee.
Shadow, Kali, do you copy? Status report?
We found Ancient. It was a mostly useless meeting. But Shadow now looks like one of Titan's soldiers. Ancient can change others’ forms as well as his own.
Interesting. He won't be allowed near Titan still, but I have an idea. Titan's men are holding a competition at the Incubator.
The winner will be promoted to a commander of a special squadron "Faceless" at the ceremony held at Titan's citadel. It's your chance to get close to Titan.
Shadow, Kali, do you copy? Got new intel. Looks like Shroud is completely out of control!
Titan is sending one of his retainers, a certain Justice, to bring Shroud to his senses. Here is what we’ve intercepted.
...attention all units. Everyone who gets visual contact on Shroud, report immediately. Do not approach him, he’s extremely dangerous.
Don’t even try! Friend or foe, I’ll crush everyone who stands between me and my prey!
I have intercepted another exchange of messages. Commencing transmission.
Shroud, Titan has personally ordered me to take Shadow alive. You must cooperate. Over.
I know Titan’s will. What he truly wants! Shadow dies by my hand! You shall not stop me!
The Hideout's compromised! My fighters are trying to stop Shroud, but they’re too weak! I'm in the panic room, but it’s just a matter of time before...
This is Shroud! Your base is under my control! Shadow, hear me: I will find your know-it-all friend sooner or later. Clock’s ticking, show yourself!
Shroud, my dear. At last I've found you. Was this brave soldier trying to stop you?
Stand up, soldier. Your battle isn’t over yet. It will not end until you make Shroud bite the dust. He deserves that humiliation. Fight again!
You fools! You think Titan mesmerized me? I'm here of my own free will! He’s the one who understands how to build a new world, a world without borders and wars!
All worlds share the same fate – their own destruction. Titan saves the people from the burden of killing each other, takes them under his iron fist...
Enough talking! Shroud, you will be placed in the Incubator’s feeding tub to serve as nutrition for a new generation of Titan’s military.
And you, my little winner... No normal soldier is capable of stopping Shroud. Besides, I couldn’t help but recognize your fighting style.
Long time no see, dear friend.

Get ready to meet the mighty conqueror of the shadow world!
Long time no see, dear friend. The Gates are closed, so - you want more? You want to take Titan's place, don't you?
And who's that? A new girlfriend already? Titan was right! You're not "saving the world". Chicks and power, that's all you want! Why else would you climb in here?

For me? What do you know about it?! He's not... But... are you... serious?
Attention, Justice! We demand your surrender! I have restored the Hideout's internal defense circuit; you have no other options!
Argh! Damn you, rebel! Damn you, Shadow! All that talk was just to trick me! But Titan will come! Titan will tear your heads off!
The girl has lost her mind, obviously, it's Titan's work. We can hold her here, but she'll remain like that for as long as Titan holds grip of her mind.
So it's back to plan A: we're going to the Citadel with Shadow disguised as Titan's soldier.
Folkss! I can ssmell it! Shadow Energy! Sso pure, sso undiluted! So tasssty!
So... hungry! I smell it... on you! Damn you, Titan! What... have you done... to me!
Scavengers. Titan runs horrible experiments on his prisoners, drives them mad with pain, then throws them away from the Citadel when he no longer needs them.
Shadow Energy is like both food and dope for them. Strange. The Scavengers are usually scared of Titan's soldiers, but now they seem to...
Ssee, folkss! Shadow man! He smellss so delicious! Let’ss feasst!
Kali to Cypher. The Scavengers attacked us. They were babbling about a source of "pure Shadow Energy". Do you know of it?
I understand Titan's true motives now. When you opened the Gates, Shadow Energy formed a new body for you. A capsule made of pure energy.
Should you lose this battle, Titan won't need the champions' energy - he'll have yours. Any world finding itself in his way will be reduced to ashes.
No! Fear is a luxury we can't afford. As long as you keep May under guard, Titan will not recognize Shadow. We're entering the Citadel now!
Why of course. Did you think you could trick my beasts? They know pure Shadow Energy - you can't hide! Welcome to my humble Citadel, Shadow.
You are my crowning glory! The Gates opened, and you survived the most powerful Shadow Energy emission. But you're no slave; you've retained your mind and will.
So many experiments, so many worlds... Finally, success! But before I take your power, meet some of those who, too, survived the Gates.
They were so much like you - your doubles, I might say - but lacked the will to hold so much energy...
Yours is the fame of the most talented assassin. For that is your main skill: killing. Why waste time with common rabble, doing their meaningless errands?
I took over the Order in one of the worlds, then did away with the bothersome old man and that skirt. Now only I decide who lives and who dies - I'm in control.
You let me live... That mistake will cost you dearly! One day...
Mastery of combat is above all else. I have no match, so I choose to challenge the Eternity, so that I could excel myself.
I have become the greatest Master of the Orient. The rare disciple who earns an audience with me only reminds me of my superiority.
You, wayward moron! I have founded a great school, and my name will be remembered, and pronounced gushingly! And you shall simply be forgotten...
You don't fear me? Strange. Should you had been a little braver, Shadow, you could've become me. Didn't you see people were worshiping you? Was it not obvious?
Butcher's children saw in me their messiah, one to free them from censure and morals. They are my flock now, and I lead them. Where we walk, blood will flow.
Think well, Shadow. With your potential, you could lead nations! We can be at head of a great family of faithful! I shall be waiting.
Answering the call of the ocean granted me freedom! Now, the only true law is my law. And any who stand in my way - I'll feed them to the sea devil!
Wasp was weak! Now her fleet is mine. When the land rats see my black banner heaving, they know death is coming to their towns, death with my face!
The ocean does not excuse mistakes. I shall now have to atone for my failure - atone with blood of innocents. Is that the victory you wanted?
Kneel, peasant, and behold your sovereign, who rules with an iron hand! When Shogun's head touched the ground, I took his kingdom - it was mine by rights!
You're meek, Shadow. People left to their own will shall soon destroy the State. And you are the quintessence of everything that I hate about commoners!
Cur, mongrel! Should you ever dare to trespass my kingdom, my vassals will flay you alive!
Incredible! Your power is unprecedented! I never imagined you'd be able to defeat your dark half. But you have surpassed my expectations!
Your essence belongs to me, just like the Gates that you have opened! It will open the way for me to thousands of worlds that have no heroes to guard them.
Following the call of your heart brought you into my trap. Losing your body, you gained the ability to walk between the worlds. And that shall soon be mine.
You're filled with fury, waiting to fight me, but... Once more, for the last time, I would like to watch what pure Shadow Energy is really capable of... May!
Ha! Did you think that some ragtag gang could hold me in place? Their blood is on your hands!
Restrain yourself, girlie. I've brought your buddy Cypher here to watch you fail. And you, Shadow, get a special reward for your obstinacy: fighting me!
I know every move before you make it! I have seen all your fights! How can you hope to defeat me?
No... No! What's going on? Where am I? How did I get here?
It's okay. Just breathe. Titan kidnapped you, but Shadow gave chase. Now pull yourself together. We'll have time to discuss all that happened...
Our enemy proved to be more devious than expected. It was not your fault. But you should go now, while you can! Back through the Gates and to your world.
But... how can I leave... him?
That was the purpose of Shadow's mission: to set you free. Just go! The rest of us - we have things to do here. It's your turn, Shadow!
Your world teeters on the edge of the abyss, Shadow, unaware that its fate was already decided: it's destined to become the flesh and blood of the new empire!
After you fall, I will give you some time to see the finale of that world and the birth of the new one. Sheer, wild, endless. My world!
Do not wonder, Shadow. You, humans, live in haste, but I know the value of time.
Thy friends and thy foes, they cannot see or hear us now. I have stopped the flow time so thou can take a breath. I give thee another chance.
New banners are now flying over the risen army! Ancient gave us new life, so that we should fight anyone who dares trespass in his realm.
Once we came here to take Ancient’s head, but fell to his sword. He is now gone to the war of his own. He is not here anymore.
So - Ancient has left the Stone Grove? Where did he go, I wonder?
There is more of us than you think. We shall rise from our tombs, again and again.
Titan was our lord, but it was Ancient who gave us new life. We shall protect the secrets of the Stone Grove forever!

Didn't your mother teach you not to leave anything on your plate? It shows – there's hunger in your eyes! Or… what is the matter with you?

It's so cold here! I can't feel my fingers already... Where are we? It's such strange air.
Strange air? Strange air! Strrrange air!
Get back, May! We don't know what it wants! The world of the Immortals was shaken more than I thought. After what we did, they're not happy we're here.
Not happy, not happy, not happy! We did, we did, we did!
Calm now, don't make any sudden moves. It looks like this creature isn't very smart.
But why do I feel like it understands us?
That's not important now. Going into the portal was our decision, and we have to answer for it. It wants a fight, so we have no choice, Shadow.
I expected more from the portal... Apparently the trip took your strength away, and your molecular bonds are weakened. Interesting, we must do a couple more tests.
For centuries, this rickety portal has reminded us that there are forces beyond our understanding. Then you come along...
Who are you and why did that thing attack us?
My bot? I apologize for the cold welcome. It's programmed to protect the portal. In case of danger, it attacks. But I can see you're not dangerous.
I was expecting trouble from that side. But now... Your appearance has strengthened the Obelisk. And your face, hero, is somehow familiar. But where from?
The Obelisk? What are you talking about? We only just got here and we're already in trouble! Is this a joke?
It's not just a joke, my sweet. I'd like to laugh, but we're talking about the end of the world. Come with me, I have much to tell you.

Our ruler, the Patriarch, studied the portal for years. Then, one day, he withdrew into himself. Later, he put up the Obelisk, and it did something to our world...
But what's that got to do with us?
Shadow is similar to the Obelisk on a molecular level. There's a person who will help to use that against the Patriarch. And that's why we're here in the chamber of Saturn...
Going far, kids? You came to my prison of your own free will! I wonder, is that bravery or stupidity? You, the lanky one, answer!
A thousand apologies, my lady. However, we must free Lazarus. Please show us to his cell, and we won't dare to bother you any further.
I'll ram your words back down your throat. And your friends will watch. The only way to leave my prison is via the scaffold. Who wants to go first?
That's enough for you. If Lazarus is associating with rejects like you, there's no danger to the Patriarch. Get out of here, brats! You're not on my list.
You'll never find Lazarus. That rascal escaped from my prison and hid in the marshes. You want to perish too? Then off you go after him!
You mean, he escaped his punishment... and wrapped you around his little finger? How marvelous! The Patriarch should be more careful choosing his minions.
What's out there on the marshes? Saturn speaks fearfully of them. If a fierce warrior like her didn't set off in pursuit of a dangerous fugitive...
Orders are orders, but my life is still dear to me. Besides, those rebels are not threat to the Patriarch without their leader. They're just a rabble. Urgh!
In that case, our road leads to the marshes. I hope Lazarus will tell us how Shadow is connected to the Obelisk and why the Patriarch condemned this world to death.

Hear that? Nothing! Silence. Without birdsong, it's as if this place is frozen in amber. Are we doing the right thing? I have a very bad feeling...
No wonder. Ever since a piece of the ancient Gates crashed here, life in this place has been a statistical error. Keep your eyes open, we need to find Lazarus.
Simon? What a bastard you are! Why did you bring people here? It'll catch the scent of your thoughts! Get away from here before the Blackness gets a taste of your thoughts!
These wonderful gentlemen are your ticket to freedom, my dear. The big guy in black is connected somehow to the Obelisk and the Gates. He helps you, and you help him.
What's the matter, Shadow? Are you sick?
Offspring. A great sacrifice. A sphere. The mind. Butchery. I feel. You will spill blood. I see pain. I see the future. I'll show you.
You stay here. Eternally. One blood. Forever. I will read you. I will feed.
I don't like it that somebody's taking my will away, my dear! It's an offense to my intellect! Shadow, you have to get us out of here!
Whose form has it taken? Does that tell you anything, Shadow? It was definitely speaking to you. I'm getting chills like I saw a ghost...
One blood, of course! Thank you for returning me a part of myself. This is where our paths diverge. Now they will pay. Stupid, insignificant people!
Wait, my dear! This isn't what we agreed! Unnecessary victims are unacceptable! You're upset, I understand, but let go your emotions... And engage your brain!
You lied to us, man of science! Who did we free? What have we condemned this world to? Do you realize what you've done?!
I made a mistake in my calculations... We have to get to the city before Lazarus razes it to the ground along with the Patriarch! The innocent will suffer! Let's go!

You moron! What do you think you're doing, Junior?! C'mon, drop that shooting stick before you get yourself hurt! And what've you got in that sack?
It's a musket, father. A human weapon. Just wait 'til you hear it boom! Just like the cracking of a February frost! Bang!
Stop your childishness! This is no toy! Who gave you that dangerous weapon, son? Did you steal it? Take it by force?
Somebody saw potential in my time magic, unlike you! We didn't steal a thing! We were just working together… To help!
Getting into trouble again, young Freeze? Taking things from your time like that could cause a paradox! Tell me the name of whoever put you up to this!
Stand aside, old timer. Don't raise my son for me. I see kind words won't get me anywhere. I won't ask again: who was with you?
You have no imagination, Father. A lot of things that can help people have been lost in time. And we can make a little money off it. Is that such a bad thing?
If you won't play by my rules, son, I'll take that sack of yours and lock it away until next year…
As much as I'd like to keep this between you, we must interfere. Father and son have nothing to share. Shadow, however, can put the youngster in his place.
Shadow, take that sack from Junior before time fractures!
It was all Sly! He promised he'd give me the musket as long as I got these things for him. And the sack holds an anomaly that prevents time rifts! Relax!
Sly, huh? That cunning devil… Didn't he explain to you that you could wipe us from the pages of history just by stepping on some flower?!
Correct. Time, as you may have realized, is deceptive. Treacherous. Stop it, and the world simply holds its breath, but change it, and you'll lose your very self.
Come, my son. Tell me about the times you've seen. And I'll listen, something I've never done before. We'll find a solution together.
How strange… I was expecting Lazarus to flatten the Obelisk to dust. I was afraid to see the carnage, but it seems that only you and I are here. I'm intrigued.
Silence is a bad omen, my rational friend. It can say more than the loudest of words. Hmm, where are we? What is this bizarre place?
The Concentration Hall. You see that crystal in the center? That's how the Obelisk accumulates shadow energy. The heart of darkness, so to speak.
Look! There's something inside the crystal… Is it meant to be like that?
I doubt that, my dear… This place looks different from how I saw it last. I'm beginning to think the old man was right…
You! Hey, yooou! Come to finish what you staaarted, huh? You? There's a power to you. It ssspeaks to me. Hush! Or I'll maaake you!
Lay dooown. I'll leeeeave you here foreveeeer. Don't cause mooore harm.
Stop, Shadow-human! Don't let it ssssspreeeeaad! You'll beee like hiiiiiiiim. You shall be decccceived! But you still have a chaaaanccce.
What the helium?! The Imperial ring! My friends, we just… overthrew the Patriarch. So what, "Long live the king?"
Did Lazarus do that to him? Why did we free his spirit in that forest…
A son wouldn't raise his hand against his father. No, this is far more complicated… Shadow? You don't look so good. Can you hear me? How. Man-; Fing; Holdin; Up? You…
Hello, Shadow. Finally, we can speak in private. Did you miss me, brother?
The flighty Lord of the Frost jeopardizes the existence of the universe when he finds artifacts from different historical eras!

Have our paths crossed before? I daresay I've already beheld those dazzling rays of yours... Say, don't our faces tell you anything?
I... I'm the Sun Lord, shepherd of my people! Must a higher being remember all the common rabble? Do you dare engage in combat with a living god?
Of course, my Lord, of course. Only it seems that you went by another name the last time we met—Son of the Sun. Did that slip your mind?
Uh... yes, quite right! I was merely testing you, human! I demand a duel to entertain our esteemed audience! They're watching us, and they hunger for a show!
Something doesn't add up here. The Son of the Sun is poised and mannered. You simply look like him. Leave our dwelling before Shadow boxes your ears.
No, old man, I cannot do that. Only one shall be left standing after this battle. And it won't be that silent bully of yours. Attack!
I can't believe I did it! I took down that beast with my own hands! Uh, I mean... Never cross a god, mortal! Open your soul to the Sun!
Shadow, he's drenched in sweat! He's tired too! How does that old saying go? "I regard nothing human as foreign to me," right? How in the... You must teach this imposter a lesson! Get up!
No, I can't lose! They won't set me free! Just let me win! Pretend, and I'll pay you back! Please...
It's high time to dispel this illusion. You keep glancing around. Who are you afraid of? Who's watching us?
The Sun Cult. They believe me to be their deity. We're just alike... I adored all the attention, but now this deception is going to cost me dearly...
We'll find the real Son of the Sun before his people stir up trouble. Tell no more lies, stranger, and we will protect you. Tell us everything about this cult.
Here I stand before you, bask in my dazzling rays of greatness! Behold as my luminary fury descends upon you! Accept my challenge!

Knock, knock! Hey, old friends! This is the voice of fate, and she is on her way! Her red hem smolders like life itself at the end of the day!
Is it for your soul that she's here? Look now upon a tale as ancient as the world itself — the legend of Nrityu, whose fate it was to be a taker of lives.
That voice... It appears that our old adversary is up to something again. Who will be the victim this time? I see a man running towards the pagoda...
Open up or I'll break down this damn door! I know you're home! I can hear you! I'll put this shack to flames if you don't grant me shelter!
Your clothes are covered in filth and soot, stranger. And your tone makes me uneasy. Explain who you are and what you're doing at our doorstep!
The ghosts are all chattering. You can't trust them. And besides, it's not their story. I'll show you the truth through her eyes. Shadow, you're the only one who can understand.
The moon is particularly cold tonight. She's deaf to your pleas, villain. You have taken lives, and now I will take yours! Nobody will cry for you!
Oh, how fiercely mortals cling to life. It wasn't me who chose this work, and I won't shed my venomous tears over it... Why have you done this to me?
But the creator says nothing. He gave her the crown of death itself, and now every mortal — good or bad — sees her face at the very end. She continues.
There! You fall into eternal sleep, although you don't deserve it. But it's not for me to judge you. That is another's calling. I am but the escort.
Nrityu looks around. Dandy wasn't alone. Behind the trees hides the girl who made the mistake. It was her who lit the flames. Was it out of fear?
Your thoughts are jumbled, Faradeya. I hear the voices in your head. They torment and lead you into doubt. You're tired. You want peace. I will give it to you.
Get back! I didn't want this! My family was afraid of me, and I thought this was my chance... Dandy promised to take me with him, if I helped...
I can read you like an open book. Your fear brings sadness to my heart. But your time has come, girl. I'd like to put down my blade but I can't.
A cornered little creature... In moments of misery, you call my name, but at the end you refuse to accept my gift. Cast off your fear and come with me!
Her heart is filled with love. The gods create us pure, but we choose our own path. Nrityu begins to understand this as she listens to the girl's story.
Faradeya breathes freely for the first time. Nrityu takes her by the hand and leads her away. The story is as eternal as creation itself. It will play out again.
This story is deep even for you. I'm surprised! But what's the moral here? Why are you showing it to us?
Nrityu is tender-hearted, and nothing human is strange to her. She feels, she errs, she angers, but she does what fate would have her do.
Just like you, Shadow. I want you to follow Nrityu's path. It took her an eternity to understand her place.
Do you have the spirit required to direct fate? Decide mine, humble servant of the arts that I am. Only in combat do you understand what's what. Be bold, Shadow, attack!
Shadow, your performance has no passion or commitment to the part. I'll give you another chance. Don't act it, live it!
The show goes on! You, Shadow, will be the star, and my actors will be your supporting players. The story of Nrityu will be our greatest production!

The cleansing fire is just. That's what our ancestors said. But they did not know that Immortals care not for human morality. That is the way they are.
Do you feel the heat coming from under the ground? There's just one thing you must know: the flame spares no one, be they friend or stranger. And we stand in its way.
The witch scares you without reason. It is much simpler than that: steel is tempered in fire! The gods understand power and nothing else. That alone can return them to their slumber! Attack!
It's as hot as hellfire here... The fire spirit is growling contentedly in its vault! A fine fight indeed, Shadow! We have earned another day!
You have paid tribute to the insatiable god, hero. I can feel it. The flame will go out, but the light that will illuminate the path of our descendants will burn only brighter.
You ought to get back on your feet, Shadow! Do you feel the ground quaking?! The god is disgusted by our messing around in the dirt...
I believe that the flame of your heart burns brighter than the crazed god's blind rage. And your time has come to shine your light on us, hero! Arise!
