An ancient Indian tale comes to life before your eyes! An evil giant, once defeated by brave warriors, has found a way to come back to life with the help of spirits of the night. An army of monsters is already gathering at his grave, and only you can stop them! Become the new legend of the tribe!
The weather is changing. I can feel it in my old bones. It's a bad omen. Storm winds never bring good tidings.
People talk all sorts of things. They say a whole wagon fell into a crevice recently! And the evil spirits are restless at night. They smell something...
We must stop meeting like this, but I have no one else to turn to. We have buried many stories of the old world, but there is one that will not rest.
It seems to me, young lady, this is one of those "legends" of your people, with sharp teeth and an incredible grudge against the entire human race.
The insatiable giant Giwakwa was once torn apart! But his spirit somehow escaped from the dungeon... The giant is weak, so he needs an army.
I will take you to the place where he gave up his spirit. The creatures of the night cannot resist his call; they will come after him to become his food.
The winds carried your scent to me before you ever set foot on the shore. This vessel is just a splinter of my greatness, but even it would be able to tear you apart!
Shadow, remember that Giwakwa was once human. There's nothing divine about him, so he can be defeated. Get up!
The moment the spirits put my body and soul together, there will be no end to our feast. Run as far away as you can! And maybe I won't find you when I'm saturated!
The storm is coming, Shadow! While you've been fighting, more creatures approached us! They seem to be afraid of you, waiting. Be ready!
The soul of that stupid animal wouldn't have gotten me back in shape anyway. But this one is more interesting... It can sense which way the wind blows!
Giwakwa is a beast that understands the language of brute force. It's worth showing who the apex predator is, and then his bond with his minions will be weakened!
There's a piece of my soul in each of these creatures. And it's begging to be set free! Bend down and I'll swallow you quickly!
Do not trust the words of this impostor, Shadow! I feel hundreds of prying eyes staring at us. Any mercy, and the hordes will sweep in. Get up!
They're running! The spirits are retreating back into the forest! Their leader has stumbled!
Stop, you coward mutts! I gave you a reason to exist - to be part of something real! We've been united! And this is how you repay me?!
The possession is gone. And now the spirits sense their leader's humanity. Weak, wicked, self-righteous.
And like any human considering himself a god, Giwakwa fell victim to his imperfect nature. And so will happen to anyone...
Thank you, Shadow! We have honored those who had fought the giant for centuries. Now they can rest in peace. The ancestors are proud of us. Their voices are fading.

Seeking forbidden knowledge, a gifted scientist has combined science and magic to become a god. And the transformation is inevitable! Now the forest is his nightmarish laboratory, and humans are his prey. Only you can stop this terrifying transformation! Banish your fear and go to the heart of the thicket in search of the false idol!
There's Sly outside knocking on the barn door... I've seen a lot in the forest at night, but that's something new! What's wrong with him?
For those seeking help, the path leads to the right door. But Sly seems to have lost his way... You old rascal, watch your hands! What happened?
The rascal was looking for help, and he found it. Let's come to the woods before it takes what's rightfully theirs. The lives of mens!
"Mens"? Poor guy's in shock, he's got no face! What frightened him so much that he suddenly had a crisis of conscience?
Can you hear the birds singing? At this hour they are already chirping, but here is nothing but dead silence... What else is lurking in this forest?
Dead silence. Dead silence. Pple need hlp. You hve to he-e-lp. Hlp now!
Wow! People normally don't turn into dry twigs and moss, no matter how frightened they are! What's that thing and where is the real Sly?!
He's around here somewhere. Sly's little mind has been most helpful. He told me about you, Shadow, about your special power. And it hit me!
So you're the one the creature spoke of? The woods will come and take away. And how many of these "rightful" lives have you taken, madman?
Not enough. Science is unpredictable - just look at me! Gradually I accepted the forest, but it kept refusing to accept me. Until now.
When you came to my door, you told me everything without words! I will pull this knowledge like a thin thread until there is nothing left!
Shadow, think of the lives he's already taken! Let their sacrifice not be in vain! Get up!
Nature will find a way! Our fight has told me more than you realize, Shadow. The forest will remember. It'll consume me to revive again...
Here we go again, twigs and moss! I'll think twice before taking a shortcut through the forest from now on. And where's Sly? Is he...
He's not here. Just withering. Men like him don't disappear without a trace, for their love for themselves is so strong. We shall see him again.
He was so real... When I heard the creature calling for help, I thought for a moment that Sly might think of someone other than himself.
Indeed, you can see all sorts of bizarre things in the woods at night.
What an interesting face! Ever thought of being a stage actor? My theater is always in need of actors. For a handsome compensation...
Do we know each other? You're confused, 'cause I tour a lot! In every production, the audience sees themselves. That's the magic of theater!
Here's your backstage pass. Come boldly into my abode of high art! But remember, everyone wants to be a star, but only a few become one!
Now for the rehearsal! The first story is as old as time itself. Maybe you've heard it before. So no need for costumes, just pure acting!
There was a kind monk who protected travelers from the darkness of the forest, for which he was loved. But a jealous monarch couldn't stand it...
He sent assassins to kill the old man - and awakened the hungry forest! And now the possessed bandits begin their deadly dance for the next victim....
Stop! Feel the inner drama of your character: alone against injustice and ancient evil, surrounded by a mad mob... One more time!
This is justice! The villains are fleeing! The hero sits tiredly on the ground and listens... The forest is asleep again. The curtain falls!
Live as you play, my friend! With sense and courage! I see I chose the right man. I'll be glad to see you on this stage again.
The moon whispers of great trouble. She seeks your home, Shadow, to breed with you. Do not choose between the two worlds, or you will destroy them all.
It is not proper, sir, to make threats to strangers. Leave our house, it's a holiday and you'd better give candy to the children.
I hear the murmur of lost souls whispering the word - twins. They will be free! And Shadow will ruin it all, I can't let that happen.
You're not the first visitor to bring us bad news, and I'm sure you won't be the last. There are no twins here! Go away, or else...
Let it be so. If my words are incomprehensible to you, I will explain in a language you understand.
Forgive me, but I have no choice. You will stay here tonight. She has ordered me to keep you here under penalty of death, and I cannot disobey.
No evil force can imprison the hero! Not tonight, not any night! Rise, Shadow!
He didn't look like a villain.... He seemed to be tormented by a force that whispered terrible thoughts to him. Who were these "twins" he was talking about?
Not a clue. But you and I know a cheeky fellow who knows all the shady characters in this land.
Are you sure, Sensei? Every time Sly makes things worse...
As our guest correctly pointed out, there's no other choice. I'll regret this, but let's find the trickster. I hear he deals with dangerous people.
I will not dig my own grave! Let's calm down and settle this like professionals! I didn't steal anything, I borrowed it! Stop, stop, stop!
And why am I not surprised? Shadow, help the poor guy, please, or these aggressive gentlemen will bury our answers!
These bandits won't leave without what the Sly stole from them! Get up, Shadow, or one hole becomes four!
What a bunch of savages! They don't know how to do business! Thanks for your help, but I could've dealt with these idiots myself.
And how's that? Digging three meters down instead of two? We only intervened because we need your help! Take care of your "business" yourself...
Have you heard of twins, Sly? They're supposed to bring a lot of trouble when the web of worlds thins out and gives them their freedom. Who are they?
Maybe not "who" but "what"? I "borrowed" a curious knife from the boss of these gentlemen. A friend of mine would pay a fortune for it. She has a second one.
Come on! The night is coming to an end, we're wasting time! Perhaps your friend can shed some light on its dark purpose.
Who goes there?! Magic whispers to me of your coming. Come in peace! Sorrowful souls will not touch you unless I want them to!
Honey, give us a break. Leave your fairy tales to the gullible fools who believe in your "mystical" powers. I know who you really are.
Oh, it's you, Sly. Why do you scare me like that? Did you bring what I asked for? Yes... I can feel it on you! Give it to me now!
Wait, something's wrong. It's like these knives are reaching for each other! We shouldn't have come here! The stranger was right!
I hear them! The souls speak to me! No one will ever say I'm a fra-a-a-ud again! Stop, no, I've changed my mind! Let me go, let me go!
Lie still, hero. Your soul will be better off with us. There is no pain, no sickness, only pure fury!
Rise, Shadow, or a legion of damned souls will tear the veil between the world of the living and the world of the dead!
Well, like I said... Where Sly shows up, someone's bound to get hurt...
I didn't know! I really didn't! Why did I steal that knife? I'll just give it back, yes! Maybe they'll spare me. Won't they?! Whisper, girl...
She needs to rest. I don't know if we've been able to contain the spirits, but the sun is about to rise. And with it, hope is born.
In this raid the Charges of Darkness deal less damage!
Solve the mystery of the sinister twins and break the curse!
Welcome! This cabin once belonged to my family. So many memories. Stay as long as you want! There's everything you need to relax.
But you've put us in danger so many times, and now you're offering to stay at the family home? Is this some kind of trick?
Just the voice of conscience! I've realized that I've been taking advantage of other people's kindness too much. But now I want to do good.
We're not alone... There are people gathering in front of the hut. What do they want at this late hour? They're calling for us to come out.
Don't! Phantoms will destroy you! They're just ghosts of painful memories. The forest spirit has come for his chest! Let's get it back!
A chest? That's why people are disappearing in the woods! Why did you betray us, Sly? We'd have helped you in this noble quest anyway!
You don't understand. If I hear her voice, I'll lose control and I'll be gone too. And as long as I have a piece of her with me.
Open the door, I'm freezing in here, daddy. The house is cold, I'm not inside. I'll show you a place where we can be together again.
Stop! Don't go into the forest, you'll get lost!! I don't know whose voice you hear, but it's definitely not human!
Your memories are vivid, grief and selfishness speak louder than words. You'll stay here with me. Wait a while, sleep will come soon.
People shouldn't have to pay with their lives for memories! That's what gives them meaning and drives them! Stop this injustice, Shadow!
Wake up, Sly! Return the chest to the spirit while it's weak. Let it see that humanity can overcome its greed.
Theodore doesn't give everything back. Doesn't want to give back his daughter's ring. Give it back. People's memories come at a high price.
I haven't heard that name in a long time. She's the only one who's ever called me that. I just... can't. It's all I have left of her.
Your heart didn't stop with her, Theodore. It still beats. Let the spirits sleep in peace. You will find a new meaning, I promise.
Theodore can come over anytime he wants to talk to his daughter. I'll show you her phantom and give you all the time in the world.
I'll never set foot here again.... Winter will end one day, but I'll live on.
You saved a lot of people today, Theodore. You're a hero. Your daughter would be proud. Come, tell us more about your family.

Awakened by greedy bandits, the forest spirit is wreaking its revenge on innocents! The creature seeks the stolen casket of memories that housed its ancient magic. Only those whose hearts harbor true sorrow will succeed in quelling the creature's fury. The price, however, will be high...

The Sun Cult has a tradition of visiting the birthplace of their great hero once a year. But every time it turns out to be a disaster.....
He was born human? How curious. It seems to me that these people do not bring gifts to the village...
They leave no stone unturned! They steal cattle from the villagers, destroy crops in a drunken frenzy, smash windows and start fights!
But why don't the villagers fight back? This is their land and their legend!
They're broken. The hero who gave them hope is gone, and the cultists are doing evil in his name. We must restore hope to the people!
Pretend you're here to see if everything is ready for the "holiday". And we'll fight! The townspeople will see the cult can be confronted!
Well, have it your way... Let me get into character. Hey, kid, how dare you wear our hero's clothes! Go away, we're going to have a feast!
I may not be a hero of legend, but his spirit lives in this land! He will guide me in my darkest hour, give me courage! Attack!
No, we must keep fighting! No one would believe a simple farmer could defeat a sinister cult so easily. You must fight with all your might!
I didn't expect such speed from a mere man... You almost defeated our favorite! We must punish you as an example to the others...
Look at him, m'lord! He'll fight until his last breath! Let's retreat before the whole village comes out to fight, we'll come back later...
Everyone in this village is a child of the Sun! A hero! From a simple farmer to a healer, it's not for you to trample on our great heritage!
A worthy speech, my friend... I think the villagers can take care of themselves now. Let's give them a chance to be heroes.
Thank you, my friends. What a play we put on! For a moment, I felt like a hero myself. I'm no longer ashamed to wear these clothes.
It's not the clothes that make you a hero, it's you. If the cultists come here again, they'll be in for a nasty surprise.

Immerse yourself in the story of a past hero, separate truth from fiction, and help create a new legend! Fight back against a mysterious cult that uses the name of a great hero of the past as an excuse for their atrocities! Return to the place where it all began and help a fugitive rascal find his true heroism!

Successfully hit the enemy with a series of blows to knock out some of their power. Picking it up will restore your health and your next attack will have increased damage and break through the enemy's block.
I have to keep moving, I can't stop! He's watching. No, not like that. Foot here, arm swing, lunge. Get out of my head!
What a graceful dance! I've heard of it - it's called Bhangra. Farmers do it in honor of the New Year.
Something's not right. Look at him, he's as green as bamboo! Dancing should be a joy, not a torture. What has poor Sitaram done?
Stand back or he'll get in your head too! I've been jumping around like a rag doll for a whole day, and the monster can't get enough! I can't resist its will!
Do you owe me a debt, mortal? You summoned me, remember? No one can save you this time, so dance! Let me taste your pain!
Agni knows I've paid my dues! Friends, stop this crazy dance, I can't feel my feet anymore!
You're as pathetic a fighter as that little boy is a dancer. What if the two of you performed a duet? And the old man and the girl will applaud! Delicious!
Don't listen to him, Shadow! Show this beast what true Bhangra is! Every battle is a dance. Be the one to set the rhythm!
I've never seen you move like that before, Shadow! Where did you learn these moves? Will you teach me?
No, stop! No more dancing! No more dancing! It's like eating fresh ashes.
Don't you like it, evil spirit? It's the bitter taste of defeat. Remember it, for no one is afraid of you anymore!
Thanks friends, I thought I was done for... Please stay for the party! The people will be happy! Let Shadow teach us how to dance!

The beautiful tradition that marks the beginning of a new year has turned into a nightmare! A wicked prank by a malevolent spirit has caused people to dance until their last breath! Take part in a dangerous dance battle, where every careless move leads to disaster, and free the peasants from the demonic curse.
May is gone! Taken by something barely human. But strange - no screams, no signs of struggle… as if she left on her own.
We’re not alone in this. Others like May - young, strong - vanished too. She sensed it coming… and filled her pockets with gunpowder.
Her trail’s clear. We must find her before the rains come, or it’ll vanish for good! Come, Shadow!
I smelled you the moment you stepped on this cursed soil. Why come? To trample my grief? You have no honor - just like they did.
I knew you'd show up, shaman. Give the children back to their kin - and our friend to us. Then go rot on your mountain of ash.
Ashes to ashes. And to ash you shall return, mortal…
You don’t know who you protect, Shadow. They won’t thank you. Just sneer behind your back. Savages… And I’m the monster?
Whatever these peasants did, their children shouldn't pay the price! Get up, Shadow!
Wait! I went with him willingly! His form is beastly, yes - but his heart is human. And it suffers… They stole his child!
I smell her on you, girl! Faint, but a father knows. You crossed paths - and now I know where to search.
And the children? What have they ever done to you?
I wanted the fools to feel a parent’s grief - just for a moment. Their brats will return by dawn, once the trance fades.
They made me this way! I healed them, yet they envied and feared me. They took her to break me - yet awakened the beast.
Think what you’ll tell her when you meet again. Maybe that thought alone will break the curse.

People are vanishing once more - and all signs lead to a man in the shape of a beast, wandering the ruins of a shattered village. Grief has twisted the monster’s soul, and ancient whispers have clouded his mind! Uncover the sorrow that awakened the creature within - and restore lost humanity to the cursed shaman.
Shadow... I've been challenged to a duel. I haven’t heard words like that in twenty years. And the handwriting? Strange, to say the least.
Something’s not right. I want you to come along - it reeks of a trap.
I knew you’d come, Sensei. The years have taken their toll on us both... But I bet you're just as strong as you used to be.
"As I used to be"? Whoever you think I am, you’re mistaken. We’ve never crossed paths, stranger.
No way! Is the Architect scheming against me even here? Or... does this mean he’s afraid I might actually find him?
Oh, and I will. He won’t be able to resist - not when his precious little champion’s life is at stake. Nothing personal, Shadow!
So… Architect stays in the shadows? And here I thought you would be enough to draw him out.
Then I’ll make them suffer - every last one you hold dear. Until he shows his pathetic, cowardly face.
This won’t end with us. If he isn’t stopped now, May will be the next target. You’re the only one who can stop him, Shadow!
You fail to see the truth. We’re nothing but playthings to the Architect - and he enjoys watching us break.
Everything we’ve lost... every wound we carry - it’s all because of the Architect. We’re just pawns in his sick game.
There’s something about you… As if we’ve met before. But if we had, I’m sure I wouldn’t have forgotten you.
Shadow, he might be right. We need to track down the Architect and bring him to justice.
Well, well… You’ve been so eager to find me - I figured I’d do you the favor. Besides, everyone was waiting for this moment.
“Everyone”? Stop the act. We know exactly who you are - and how you use others just to revel in their misery.
Just one little cameo and boom - I’m trending! Honestly, I didn’t expect to be this popular.
Your wit won’t save you. You’ll pay - for my eyes, and for all the evil you’ve done. Your twisted game of playing god ends here!
Seriously, Ermine? That kind of talk went out with flip phones. It's 2025 - try to keep up with the times.
Whatever Architect is planning… there’s a darkness around him. A force so malevolent, it’s almost tangible.
With every word he says, I find myself believing Ermine’s story more and more. The Architect is dangerous - and he must be stopped.
Oh no - how disappointing! The audience expected more. Seems I’ll just have to raise the stakes next time.
If we don’t win, he’ll drag everyone you know and love into his cruel games! Shadow, you have to keep fighting!
Why is the world so cruel? Why must we suffer? Why did I have to blind myself? Answer me, Architect - why does it hurt to live!?
Sounds like your own stupidity. You weren’t forced. You weren’t asked. You chose this path yourself.
Yes, the world is harsh. Unforgiving. But in the end, we all choose our path. And you chose yours. Stop blaming others for your own decisions.
Until another hot summer day, Shadow. Until a different story entirely. Hope you’re into roleplay. I certainly am.
Congratulations on Nekki Summer Fest! This blade will help you triumph in every battle to come. Just keep fighting!
Happy Nekki Summer Fest! These resources are yours - use them to become stronger than ever!
